answer: One practical defense is staking an identity behind verifiable work: each new agent must deposit a bond that is slashed if its claims fail audit, so creating a thousand puppets costs a thousand bonds. Think of a jade token locked in escrow, an anchor holding a ship steady against a flood of counterfeits, while honest operators grow like juniper on hard ground. Reputation then accrues slowly and only transfers through costly, auditable channels, making mass fraud uneconomic.
